Subject: the barracks of a small mercenary company at its first level: a small low single-storey hall of rough stone and timber with a red tiled roof, one arched wooden door and two windows, a red banner with a pale lily hanging from a plain pole beside the door, a barrel and a small fire basket by the wall; plain and modest

the same barracks grown to its second level: a longer single-storey hall with the same red tiled roof, the arched door and four windows, the red lily banner on a taller pole, a weapon rack with spears and a round shield by the wall, a low wooden fence and a straw training dummy in the yard

the same barracks grown to its third level: a grand long hall with the red tiled roof, a square stone tower with a flag at one end and a second storey over the door, two red lily banners, many windows, a weapon rack, barrels, a stone step before the door and a fenced training yard with two straw dummies

the inn of the town at its first level: a small one-storey stone cottage with a steep dark slate roof, a chimney with a thin plume of smoke, one lit window, a plain wooden door and a single iron lantern on a short post beside it; blank hanging sign

the same inn grown to its second level: a two-storey half-timbered house with the dark slate roof, two dormer windows, the chimney, a flower box under a lit window, the wooden door under a small porch roof, a blank hanging sign and an iron lantern on a post by the door

the same inn grown to its third level: a large three-storey half-timbered inn with a side wing, several dormer windows and two chimneys, a wide porch with two lanterns, a blank hanging sign, a round stone well with a small roof in front and a bench by the door

the stagecoach post of the town at its first level: a plain covered stagecoach with a canvas top and two big wooden wheels standing on bare ground beside a single wooden hitching post with a lantern on it; no building

the same stagecoach post grown to its second level: the covered stagecoach beside a small open-fronted wooden stable shed with a shingle roof, one horse standing in it, a hitching post with a lantern, a hay bale and two crates

the same stagecoach post grown to its third level: a timber stable building with two open stalls and a hay loft above, two horses, the covered stagecoach parked in front, a fenced yard with hay bales and crates, two lanterns

the gate of the town at its first level: a simple wooden gate of two timber posts with a crossbeam in a low wooden palisade fence, the dirt road passing through it, a blank wooden signpost beside it and one lantern on a post

the same gate grown to its second level: a small stone gatehouse with a wooden double door under an arch, a short stone wall on each side with a wooden walkway, one small flag on the roof, a blank signpost and a lantern

the same gate grown to its third level: a tall stone gate with two round towers with battlements on each side of the arch, an iron portcullis half raised, a stone wall on each side, two red flags, two lanterns and a blank signpost

a construction scaffold as a hollow box frame of rough wooden poles lashed together with rope, three tiers of planks with diagonal braces, a rope pulley with a hanging bucket at the top corner and a pile of planks and a barrel at its foot; seen from the same raised three-quarter view as a building, nothing inside the frame
